title: Waterfront walks in and around Kochi
description: Four waterfront places for a walk, from Marine Drive to Cherai.
intro: Kochi has waterside places with different settings: an urban promenade, a historic beach, an island beach and an inland park. These are places to explore on foot, not measured running routes; check local access and conditions before setting out.

entries.name: Marine Drive
entries.description: Kerala Tourism describes a roughly three-kilometre promenade between High Court Junction and Rajendra Maidan. Its route along the backwaters makes it a straightforward choice for a city walk; the department notes that evenings can be busy.

entries.name: Fort Kochi Beach
entries.description: The tourism department describes a granite walkway by the beach and the adjacent Vasco da Gama Square. The area is associated with the Chinese fishing nets; it also notes that a section of the beach is under naval control and not open to visitors.

entries.name: Subhash Chandra Bose Park
entries.description: This central Ernakulam park overlooks Vembanad Lake and the harbour. Kerala Tourism places it next to the boat jetty and opposite Maharaja’s College; check current access and opening times before travelling.

entries.name: Cherai Beach
entries.description: Kerala Tourism lists a walkway and a children’s park at Cherai, on Vypin island. It is a different outing from the central Kochi waterfront, so allow for the journey and check weather and local conditions.
